description: This file is a configuration class for Spring Security in a Java application. It defines security settings such as permitted endpoints (Swagger, H2 console, health checks), disables CSRF and frame options for H2, and enables HTTP Basic authentication for other endpoints. The class utilizes Spring Security 6 and the SecurityFilterChain bean to configure HTTP security.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up Spring Security filter chain

methods.name: securityFilterChain
methods.description: Defines the security filter chain, disables CSRF, sets headers for frame options, configures URL authorization rules, and enables HTTP Basic authentication.
